先挑一个物品，再让磁铁靠近。换成另一块磁铁，还能试试“推开”。: Choose an object and move the magnet closer. Try a second magnet to discover a push as well as a pull.
把磁铁慢慢移近，观察物品。: Move the magnet closer and watch the object.
铁制回形针被吸向磁铁。: The iron clip is pulled toward the magnet.
铜和铝也是金属，但这里不会被普通磁铁明显吸住。: Copper and aluminum are metals, but an ordinary magnet does not visibly pull them in here.
木块留在原处。磁铁不会明显吸引木头。: The block stays put. Wood is not noticeably attracted to a magnet.
面对面是 S 和 N：不同的极相吸。: S faces N: opposite poles attract.
面对面是 S 和 S：相同的极相斥。: S faces S: like poles repel.
先猜一猜，再动手试试: Make a guess, then try it
互动科学场景；操作和完整解释见下方: Interactive science scene; controls and full explanations follow below
慢慢玩 · 约 5—8 分钟: Explore at your pace · About 5–8 minutes
铁制回形针会被普通磁铁明显吸引。铜和铝也是金属，却不会像回形针那样被普通磁铁吸住: An iron paper clip is strongly attracted to an ordinary magnet. Copper and aluminum are metals too, but they do not stick to an ordinary magnet like the clip. What matters is the material, not just the object’s name.
相同的极推开，不同的极拉近: Like poles push; unlike poles pull
每块磁铁有 N 极和 S 极。N 对 N、S 对 S 会相斥；N 对 S 会相吸: Each magnet has an N pole and an S pole. N facing N or S facing S repels; N facing S attracts. Red and blue are labels that help us tell the poles apart, not the cause of magnetism.
回形针、铜片、铝罐里，哪些是金属？它们都会被吸过来吗？换成两块磁铁，把其中一块掉: Which of the paper clip, copper sheet and aluminum can are metals? Will all of them be pulled in? Try two magnets and turn one around.
普通铁制回形针在外磁场中容易被磁化，因此靠近任一磁极通常都会被吸引。铜的抗磁性和: An ordinary iron clip is readily magnetized by an external field, so either magnet pole usually attracts it. Copper’s diamagnetism and aluminum’s paramagnetism are weak and produce no visible movement in this everyday demonstration. The two magnets are held on one axis and prevented from rotating so like-pole repulsion can be compared clearly; a freely moving magnet may rotate and then attract.
位移和箭头只表示方向及“靠近更明显”的定性趋势，不是磁场强度或真实加速度。铁夹具: Movement and arrows show direction and a qualitative stronger-nearby trend, not field strength or realistic acceleration. Fixtures can prevent movement too. Do not use tiny magnet beads with children. An adult should hold large enclosed magnets securely and keep them away from mouths and electronics.
拖动磁铁，观察吸住和推开的过程: Drag the magnet to explore snapping together and pushing apart
慢慢靠近，看看什么时候动: Move closer. When will it move?
开始动了……越来越快！: It is moving… faster and faster!
回形针突然贴上来了！把磁铁往回拉，它还会跟着走。: The clip snaps onto the magnet! Move the magnet back: the clip comes along.
S 对着 N，两块磁铁吸在一起。点“翻转”，看看会发生什么。: S faces N and the magnets stick together. Flip the right magnet and see what happens.
S 对着 S，还没有碰到，就把另一块磁铁推开了。: S faces S. One magnet pushes the other away without touching it.
越靠越近，拉力越来越明显，物品加快了脚步。: As the gap closes, the pull becomes stronger and the object speeds up.
拖动左边的磁铁，或者点一下“靠近试试”。先猜，再观察。: Drag the left magnet or tap “Try moving closer”. Make a guess, then watch.
拖动磁铁，或用左右方向键移动: Drag the magnet, or move it with the left and right arrow keys
动作经过放大，用来观察加速靠近、贴合和推开，不是真实磁力或速度。磁力不会突然出现: Motion is exaggerated to show speeding up, sticking and pushing apart; it does not give real magnetic forces or speeds. Magnetism does not suddenly switch on: a distant pull may be too weak to overcome friction. The right-hand object is guided along the tray, which has an end stop; the magnet cannot turn freely. Do not use tiny magnet beads with children. An adult should hold large enclosed magnets securely and keep them away from mouths and electronics.
位置和动作是教学示意，不显示未经计算的磁场或力值。: Positions and motion are illustrative; no uncalculated field or force values are shown.
翻转一次，再靠近：这次是吸住，还是推开？: Flip it and move closer again: will it pull together or push apart?
先猜它会不会动，再让磁铁慢慢靠近。: Guess whether it will move, then slowly bring the magnet closer.
铁制回形针可在外磁场中被磁化。靠近时吸引作用增强，克服托盘摩擦后开始移动，接触后: An iron paper clip can become magnetized in an external field. Attraction increases as the magnet approaches; the clip moves when it overcomes tray friction, then stays attached after contact.
同极相对产生排斥。这个托盘限制了转向，因此可观察到直线分离；自由磁铁可能先转动，: Like poles repel. This tray constrains rotation so linear separation can be observed; a free magnet may rotate to face the other magnet with unlike poles.
异极相对产生吸引。图中的运动还受到摩擦和接触约束，不能用画面位移反推出真实磁力。: Unlike poles attract. Friction and contact also constrain the illustrated motion, so screen displacement cannot be used to infer a real magnetic force.
木头、铜和铝在这个普通磁铁实验中没有明显位移。铜和铝并非完全没有磁响应，只是其响: Wood, copper and aluminum show no noticeable displacement in this ordinary-magnet experiment. Copper and aluminum do have magnetic responses, but these are weak.
